name: Certified AI Hardware Specialist
description: Specifies, validates and troubleshoots AI hardware.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Hardware Specialist

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI Hardware Fundamentals: GPUs, CPUs, Memory, Networking and Storage (HW-101); GPU Hardware Deep Dive: Architecture, Memory and Interconnects (HW-201); Networking Hardware for AI: NICs, DPUs, Switches and Optics (HW-203); Storage Hardware for AI: NVMe, SSD Endurance, Arrays and GPUDirect Storage (HW-204). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
